messages:
Kait: quick design sync from user testing -> recurring confusions in routing editor. dropping notes.
Vik: thanks. bullets please so eng can size.
Kait: TL;DR: 1) People read the left-to-right list as "order" but the numeric field suggests otherwise. 2) Priority collisions show a red 'invalid' badge with no path to fix. 3) Preview popover drops content on mouse-out and is truncated differently than runtime. 4) Drag handle not keyboard operable and no visible focus state.
Samir: Agree with #1. Proposal: add a small header: "Execution order (top → bottom)" and make numbers secondary (muted). For power users, enable an "Edit precedence" mode that makes numbers editable.
Lou: Alternative idea: leave numbers visible but show a left-side position chip (#1, #2) that mirrors visual order. Less cognitive load for new users.
Kait: I like the explicit header + Advanced mode. keeps the canvas clean.
Vik: For collisions what if we add an inline "Resolve" action: a deterministic auto-rename that previews the renumbering and offers Undo? That feels less punitive than a plain error.
Samir: yes. microcopy: "Priority collision — two rules share the same priority. Choose a different priority or Auto-resolve to renumber." and the Auto-resolve button shows a preview before apply.
Lou: Simulator fixes: make it sticky until ESC or explicit close; add a pin icon so users can keep it while editing other rules. Show full match context with scroll instead of truncating single-line.
Kait: Also runtime parity: our preview truncates by characters while server truncates by tokens. short-term: add microcopy under preview: "Preview may differ from runtime for very long inputs." long-term: call runtime preview or include tokenizer lib.
Samir: Accessibility: - role=list + role=listitem for rules. - Reorder handle must be focusable with aria-roledescription="reorder handle" and support keyboard moves (Ctrl/Cmd+Up, Ctrl/Cmd+Down). - Simulator updates should be aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true"; when pinned, make it a non-modal dialog with focus trap.
Vik: Implementation note: keyboard reordering could be Cmd/Ctrl+Up/Down when row is focused; add a tiny hint overlay on focus. We'll add RFC to avoid shortcut collisions.
Lou: UX detail: saved state currently uses a green check that users read as "live". Change to neutral check + tooltip "Saved (staged). Deploy to apply." and ensure badge has descriptive text for screen readers.
Kait: Action items: design to produce two comps (default and Edit-precedence) with visible focus styles, sticky/pinned simulator interactions, and Auto-resolve preview microflow. Engineering to add keyboard moves, aria attributes, and ticket for tokenizer parity.
workflowbot: Created UX-6355: "Routing editor  execution clarity, Auto-resolve preview, simulator persistence, keyboard reorder"  assignees: Vik, Samir; priority: P2; due: 2024-07-21.
aria-bot: Accessibility checklist added to UX-6355: focus order, aria-roledescription, aria-live for simulator, announcement strings for Auto-resolve.
Kait: Thanks team — can we review comps tomorrow 11am? @Vik please include the Auto-resolve preview mock.
Vik: will do. uploading comps by EOD today. :thumbsup:
Kait: perfect. closing this thread.
